title: Something of Value
summary:
As I've previously reported,
Andrew is a professional investor who focuses on making long-term investments in what the world
calls growth companies, and especially technology companies. Growth stocks have meaningfully outperformed value for the last 13 years. My extensive discussions with Andrew led me to
conclude that the focus on value versus growth doesn't serve investors well in the fast-changing
world in which we live.
